name: Anetan Spirits Expedition -in the Phantasmagoria-
original_name: アネたん Spirits Expedition―in the Phantasmagoria―
source:
A huge crack of unknown origin appeared in the northeast of the continent. Monsters start to crawl out of it as if from gates of Hell. 
It is rumored that the mystery of this world lies in the depths of this crack...
Main character is a captain of an adventurer group sent for investigation.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
大陆东北部出现了一道来历不明的巨大裂缝。怪物仿佛从地狱之门中爬出，接连涌现。
传闻，这个世界的秘密就藏在裂缝深处…
主人公是一支受命前往调查的冒险者队伍的队长。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
